analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 40.6 is exiting oversold but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement (-3.7941 to 1.3056) but lacks a strong trend reversal signal. 5-day volatility shows a pattern of gains followed by a recent drop (-0.98%), indicating a lack of clear direction. Price has broken below SMA20 ($303.42) and is testing it as resistance. 52-week position at 17.3% remains low.

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건: RSI 50 이상 안착 및 MACD 골든크로스 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:

· Below SMA100 ($338.32)/SMA200 ($338.20): Mid-to-long-term trend weak.
· 52-week position (17.3%) + current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.9→40.6) + exiting oversold, entering neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -3.7941→1.3056) + improving, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $303.42) + band width 28.58% suggests potential volatility expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($294.08) + SMA5-based support confirmation.
· Swing resistance ($312.47) + SMA20 resistance confirmation.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of directional bias.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.94x) + moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + conditions for entry/wait: RSI confirmation above 50 and MACD golden cross.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The 5-day high/low range ($304.97/$285.68) overlaps with the 20-day high/low range ($346.58/$276.92), confirming a sideways pattern.

MACD histogram improvement (-3.7941 to 1.3056) is positive but lacks conviction for a trend reversal.
